notes.title: Spring Sale & Big Announcements: New Games, Hidden Cats, and Cozy Adventures.
notes.content:
Hello, dear Kittenwood adventurers!

We’re so grateful for your continued love and support for Kittenwood! Your excitement and kind reviews inspire us to keep creating games filled with magic, cats, and hidden treasures.

[h2]Spring Sale is Here![/h2]

The Steam Spring Sale has arrived, and if you’re looking to complete your collection, our Gemcraft’s Hidden Cat Bundle is available at a big discount! This bundle includes Kittenwood, Kittenbay, and Hidden Cat Memories, offering you more hidden object adventures filled with adorable felines.

store.steampowered.com/bundle/43994/Gemcrafts_Hidden_Cat_Bundle/

[h2]Big News: Déjà View - A Spot The Difference Game Coming Q2 2025![/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce Déjà View - A Spot The Difference Game, launching in Q2 2025! This new adventure is a fresh take on our love for cozy, spot the difference gameplay, featuring stunning artwork made by Bleeding Moon Studio.

Wishlist now and be among the first to experience this exciting new journey!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3581940/Deja_View__A_Spot_The_Difference_Game/

[h2]Mermeows - Chill Cat Mermaids Launching Late Q4 2025![/h2]

Our cozy cat mermaid game, Mermeows - Chill Cat Mermaids, is swimming your way in late Q4 2025! Decorate peaceful ponds, collect adorable mermaid kitties (Mermeows), and enjoy a relaxing, wholesome experience like no other.

Your wishlists mean the world to us and help us bring Mermeows to even more players!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457460/Mermeows_Chill_Cat_Mermaids/

[h2]More Hidden Cat Games in the Works![/h2]

We’re also working on two brand-new hidden cat games! They’re still in very early production, so we don’t have release dates yet, but rest assured, more cozy feline adventures are on the way. We can’t wait to share more details soon!

[h2]We’d Love to Hear From You![/h2]

If you’ve enjoyed Kittenwood, we’d be incredibly grateful if you could leave us a review! Your feedback helps us grow and introduces our games to new players who love hidden object adventures just like you.

Thank you for being a part of our journey. 

Happy gaming,
The Gemcraft Games Team

notes.title: Update Note 1.2.0 - Humans Talk
notes.content:
Hey Cat Detectives! Here's a quick update for version 1.2.0:

    Humans Talk: We've updated the game! Now, all humans are interactive and can talk, similar to our other games.
    Options: We've added a master and music volume slider and a text bubble duration slider in the options menu.
    New Achievements: With humans now talking, they needed their own achievements.
    UX Improvements: We've added a Home button in-game for easier return to the main menu, requiring fewer clicks.
    Various Small Fixes and Improvements.

Thanks for your support.

🌟 Happy cat finding! 🌟

notes.title: New Game Alert: PurrfectlyHiddenCats Kittenrock is Live!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Kittenwood Explorers,[/b]

In an unusual twist of events, Goldenpaw has mysteriously stepped away from the spotlight today. 🐾 Rumor has it, there's a flurry of activity behind the scenes in Kittenwood, hinting at something grand brewing just over the horizon. While we're all curious about what's being prepared (something spectacularly cool, no doubt!), we've got an exciting surprise to tide you over.

We're absolutely thrilled to present PurrfectlyHiddenCats Kittenrock, a delightful new adventure in the world of hidden objects, and guess what? It's entirely free! This isn't just any game; it's a journey into a world where every mini-story and hidden cat brings a smile and a moment of joy.

Why You'll Love Kittenrock:

[list]
[*]     Pure hidden object gameplay filled with charming mini-stories for each cat
[*]     Discover cats and hear their unique thoughts related to their surroundings
[*]     A heartfelt gift to our community, thanking you for your endless support
[/list]

While Goldenpaw is off preparing something that will surely dazzle us all, let's dive into the adorable world of Kittenrock. Who knows? You might just find some hints about what's to come in Kittenwood...

Stay tuned, adventurers. The best is yet to come!

With anticipation and purrs,

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2786450/Purrfectly_Hidden_Cats__Kittenrock/

notes.title: Update Note 1.1.1 - Cat Names and Fixes
notes.content:
Hey Cat Detectives! Here's a quick update for version 1.1.1.

Cat Names: Now see names in thought bubbles when you find our furry friends.
UI Fixes: Improved and fixed some UI issues for 16:10 resolutions - no more disappearing buttons or alignment issues.
Main Menu Redesign: Check out our sleek, slightly rearranged main menu.
'H' Key Shortcut: Press 'H' to toggle the UI panel for an unobstructed view of Kittenwood.
Bug Fixes: Minor bugs and particle issues are also fixed.

Thanks for your support. 

🌟 Happy cat finding 🌟

notes.title: Major Update Announcement - Goldenpaw Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we're thrilled to bring you a major update that has been carefully crafted to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

[b]Final Challenge Revamped 🏆[/b]

[b]• Stress-Free Gameplay: [/b]We've done away with the nerve-wracking countdown. Now, you can take on the final challenge at your own pace. But if you're up for a time challenge, we still track your best time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277168/cef0bc24055b68a29f248e110765ebb190e13e17.png[/img]

[b]• Unlimited Replays:[/b] You can now replay the final challenge as many times as you like. Just use the same summoning mechanic as you did the first time.
[b]• Pause & Play:[/b] Taking a quick break? Pause the final challenge either through the options menu or by simply pressing 'P'.

[b]Graphics & Layout Improvements 🎨[/b]

[b]• Smooth Moves:[/b] We've made all camera movements smoother for an even more immersive experience.
[b]• Main Menu Makeover:[/b] We've revamped our main menu layout, making it more intuitive and visually appealing.
[b]• Surprise!:[/b] Keep an eye out for the clickable surprises we've hidden in the main menu. Can you find them all?

[b]Quality of Life Enhancements ✨[/b]

[b]• Readability Boost: [/b]We've refined some of the in-game texts for clarity.
[b]• Bug Busters:[/b] As always, we've swatted a few minor bugs to make sure your gameplay remains smooth and glitch-free.

Thank you for your continuous support and feedback. Dive in, explore the updates, and let us know what you think.

Enjoy the game! 🎮🌟

notes.title: Update Note 1.0.1b - Reset needed
notes.content:
Good news, we've released a hotfix that resolves the quirky green cat counter issue that didn't gave the achievement. Thanks for pointing it out!

Also we heard you all and we extended the chase time from 3 to 5 minutes. 

[i]Please note: Due to the recent update aimed at correcting some identification issues, all ongoing games have been affected. To address this, it will be necessary to initiate a reset from the options menu. You can choose either a soft or a full reset. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.[/i]

Happy gaming!
